items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: guy that played tenor with him back there. I hope the guy's still living because he was quite a guy -- named Tod Howard. I don't know remember if you ever met him.

ctx.x: And he was far ahead of them. And, man, I used to get up in his hotel room sometimes, and he'd open up his suitcase, and he'd have everything just so immaculate, have his cash there and he had his contracts. He was just a strict businessman, you know, and he had a guy that played tenor with him back there. I hope the guy's still living because he was quite a guy -- named Tod Howard. I don't know remember if you ever met him.
